description: Residuos eléctricos. RAEE. Contenedores de recogida selectiva de aparatos eléctricos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Santa Cruz de Tenerife. Geolocation of WEEE containers with specifications of capacity and number of containers for each collection point. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Santa Cruz de Tenerife. The portal shows the English title as "Electrical waste. WEEE. Separate collection containers for electrical equipment" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Santa Cruz de Tenerife. Its keywords include medio-ambiente. The listing shows 2019-05-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
